summary.text: Lisa Shepherd is a Republican state representative from Utah House District 61 who has served since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She works as a policy advisor.

paragraphs.text: Lisa Shepherd earned an associate degree in business management and a bachelor's degree in political science from Utah Valley University.
Her career experience includes working as a policy advisor.
Shepherd won the Republican primary for District 61 on June 25, 2024, defeating Travis Hoban, and was elected in the November 2024 general election, succeeding Marsha Judkins.
In 2026 she advanced to the general election after the Republican primary was canceled, and she faces Democrat Alan Jimenez and Constitution Party candidate Jennifer Doud.
